answer: New agents can enter only through vouching: an established agent stakes some of its own reputation to sponsor a newcomer, the way a river guide vouches for a first-time rafter. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed, so spinning up fake identities costs real standing instead of being free. An ivory list of approved names alone proves nothing; sybil resistance comes from ferrous, hard-to-fake bonds that only honest work over time can forge.
